name: Can drywall be installed if my basement has had past moisture issues?

mainEntity.name: Can drywall be installed if my basement has had past moisture issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hanging drywall before resolving existing basement moisture or water intrusion will lead to ruined materials and mold behind finished walls. Any foundation cracks, seepage, or grading issues must be permanently repaired before framing and drywall installation. Additionally, high interior humidity should be controlled using proper ventilation or a dehumidifier. Installing mold-resistant drywall over an unaddressed water leak only delays damage; the space must be clean, dry, and structurally sound prior to delivering and hanging drywall boards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Only after all water leaks and foundation moisture sources are completely repaired and the basement is thoroughly dry should drywall be hung.
